items.stem: In LEED, what is the difference between a prerequisite and a credit?

options.text: Prerequisites are mandatory and earn no points; credits are optional and earn points
options.rationale: Correct: prerequisites must be met for certification and award no points, while credits are optional and contribute points.

options.text: Prerequisites earn the most points; credits earn none
options.rationale: Prerequisites earn no points; this is incorrect.
They differ in whether they are mandatory and whether they earn points.

options.text: Credits are mandatory and prerequisites are optional

items.explanation: Correct: prerequisites must be met for certification and award no points, while credits are optional and contribute points.

items.stem: A LEED BD+C project cannot demonstrate it meets the minimum energy performance prerequisite. What is the consequence?

options.text: The project cannot be certified until the prerequisite is met
options.rationale: Correct: all prerequisites are mandatory; failing one blocks certification regardless of credit points.
Failing a prerequisite blocks certification, not achieves the highest level.

options.text: The prerequisite can be ignored if enough credits are earned
options.rationale: Credits cannot substitute for mandatory prerequisites.
A missed prerequisite blocks the whole certification, not just Innovation.

items.stem: Select TWO statements that are TRUE about pursuing LEED credits across categories.

options.text: A credit scorecard helps a team plan which credits to pursue to reach a target level
options.rationale: Correct: a scorecard is used to plan feasible credits toward a certification target.

options.text: Documentation is required to substantiate each credit claimed
options.rationale: Correct: credits must be documented to be awarded.

options.text: Any expensive material automatically earns a Materials & Resources credit
options.rationale: Cost alone does not earn credits; specific documented requirements must be met.

options.text: Credits can be claimed without any supporting evidence
options.rationale: Credits require documentation and cannot be claimed unsupported.

options.text: Earning innovation points removes the need for prerequisites
options.rationale: Prerequisites remain mandatory regardless of innovation points.
